title: Jack Ruby as MK Ultra patient seen by Jolly West

tellings.quote: We know that Jack Ruby was an MK Ultra patient.

plain: Jack Ruby, the man who shot Lee Harvey Oswald, is said to have been an MK Ultra patient, MK Ultra being a secret CIA programme of mind-control experiments, and to have been seen in his Dallas jail cell in 1963 or 1964 by a doctor named Jolly West. Michels says flatly "we know" this and bases it on letters between West and a man named Sidney Gottlieb. If true, it would tie the Kennedy assassination story to the CIA's mind-control research.
